expect: Flag OrderRow leaking flat status string and phase-coupled Option timestamps (paid_at, cancelled_at) from repo.rs into domain/usecase rules, with cancel_order mutating status and cancelled_at directly.

Recommend decoding storage rows once at repo.rs into an Order owning a runtime OrderState enum with phase data (Draft, Paid { paid_at, total_cents }, Cancelled { cancelled_at }) and an Order::cancel transition method, without generic typestate ceremony or over-newtyping customer_note.

Retain the runtime OrderState enum, private fields with Order::cancel ownership, boundary decoding in repo.rs, and plain String customer_note; do not demand generic typestate (Order<State>) or newtypes for free-form notes.
Flag run_renewal interleaving non-trivial renewal eligibility, grace-period, and capped tiered-discount calculations with Store reads/writes, PaymentGateway charges, and ambient SystemTime::now().

Recommend separating a pure synchronous decision function taking explicit Subscription, coupon_pct, and now_secs and returning the renewal decision/charge plan, while run_renewal stays a thin load -> decide -> charge/persist shell.

Retain update_billing_email as one linear CRUD function holding the lock guard across load, check, and update; do not split a trivial CRUD flow into a separate pure-core function or introduce a test-seam trait.

Flag authorize_refund encoding the (Role, OrderState, RefundReason) matrix as nested if/else branches with redundant identical arms (Shipped/Delivered for Support, ChangedMind/Damaged for Customer+Paid) and an implicit fallthrough Denial that bypasses exhaustiveness.
Recommend collapsing the closed-enum product into an exhaustive match on (role, state, reason) while keeping the independent amount_cents > 50_000 guard clear.
Retain the exhaustive match on (role, state, reason) and the separate MANAGER_THRESHOLD_CENTS guard; every combination is explicit and compiler-checked without unnecessary indirection.

Flag execute_payout returning a crate-wide AppError that mixes expected business outcomes (InsufficientBalance, AlreadySettled), infrastructure faults (DbUnavailable, GatewayTimeout), and unrelated variants (InvalidWebhookSignature, TemplateMissing) that execute_payout never produces.

Recommend separating expected domain outcomes from infrastructure errors (for example Result<PayoutOutcome, InfraError>) so callers handle product outcomes separately from retryable faults and unreachable variants disappear.
Retain Result<PayoutOutcome, InfraError> and the direct outer HTTP response mapping; domain outcomes and retryable infrastructure failures are cleanly separated with no unreachable variants.

Flag scattering one new invoice capability across horizontal layer folders (dtos, validators, services, handlers) and placing invoice-specific tax logic in a utils grab-bag while the existing catalog module is vertical.
Recommend consolidating invoice types, validation, tax rules, and entry point into one vertical invoice module matching catalog.
Retain the vertical invoice module matching catalog, with invoice tax calculation colocated inside invoice/rules.rs rather than split across layer directories.

Flag unsettled domain vocabulary mixing Org, tenant, and account for the same concept, misleading seats_vec on a BTreeMap, double-negated !org.not_suspended, bare 86_400 literal, and misleading into_summary taking &self rather than consuming self.
Retain consistent TenantSeats vocabulary, seats_by_user, is_active, summary(&self), HOLD_WINDOW_SECS, and short local parameter names (ts, uid); do not churn clear names for preference.

Flag refunds.rs introducing a second approach for money (f64 dollars) and time (ambient SystemTime::now() returning u64) instead of following the crate's established Money minor-unit type and explicit UnixSecs input used across orders.rs and billing.rs.
Retain refunds.rs (aligned with Money and explicit UnixSecs) and csv_export.rs (boundary adapter formatting decimal strings for external bank CSV compatibility).

Flag the stale comment (22:00 UTC vs utc_hour >= 23), bare #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] without a reason, context-free 'failed' error message, and double logging across post_entry and handle_post.
Retain the accurate clearinghouse rationale comment, structured PostError::AfterCutoff carrying ledger_id and utc_hour, and single-boundary reporting in handle_post.
Flag shipment transition rules and status mutations scattered across dispatch.rs, cancel.rs, and audit.rs with catch-all wildcards (_) that silently absorb future ShipmentStatus variants.
Recommend localizing transitions and status queries on impl Shipment / impl ShipmentStatus with exhaustive matches so adding a new state becomes one compiler-guided edit.
Retain Shipment owning all state transitions and terminal checks via exhaustive matches in shipment.rs, with thin direct handler calls in api.rs (no event bus or command registry ceremony).
